decisions.title: Pi-scoped model picker with full-list toggle
decisions.rationale: ce-workflow model dialogs now start with ctx.scopedModels when Pi configured a scope, preserve pinned thinking metadata, and let the operator press Tab to switch between scoped and full registries. Empty scopes retain the existing full-list behavior.
decisions.verification: node scripts/test-work-settings.mjs passed and covers scoped-first display, thinking metadata, keyboard filtering, and Tab switching to the full list

decisions.title: Session, concurrent bash, resource, and tool-output lifecycle fixes
decisions.rationale: Abort-before-replacement, tree persistence, concurrent bash cancellation, direct RPC user_bash, startup rebind, resource metadata, and tool-output status are host-owned behavior inherited by ce-workflow's existing extension hooks.

decisions.title: TypeBox 1.3.7 alias removals
decisions.rationale: The repository has no call sites for the removed Type.Base, Type.Awaited, Type.Promise, Type.AsyncIterator, Type.Iterator, Type.Options, or Value.Mutate aliases, so no compatibility edit is required.

decisions.title: Credential export, provider login, model, and transport additions
decisions.rationale: Credential export, headless OpenRouter login, Copilot Opus 5, per-request fetch injection, and provider stop-reason changes belong to CLI/provider surfaces that ce-workflow neither registers nor wraps.

decisions.title: Project-grounded proactive catch-up verdicts
decisions.rationale: ce-pov turns upstream release notes into repository-specific adoption decisions before the baseline advances.
decisions.verification: work-catch-up objective and completion-gate tests passed

decisions.title: Technical explainers for difficult adoption choices
decisions.rationale: ce-explain is useful only when a candidate cannot be decided from the compact POV summary.
decisions.verification: work-catch-up objective test covers conditional ce-explain guidance

decisions.title: Recurring external feedback sweep
decisions.rationale: ce-sweep overlaps the native work-item and improvement-reporting flow until Slack, GitHub Issues, or email ingestion is explicitly configured.

decisions.title: Structured fleetStatus RPC for Work Fleet
decisions.rationale: The new bounded current-session projection is display-only: its opaque keys omit run, async, work-item, state, and artifact identities. ce-workflow's Fleet needs those durable identities for task grouping, history, recovery evidence, transcripts, and steering, so adopting fleetStatus would add an asynchronous merge and fallback path without deleting the incumbent collectors. Revisit only if Fleet intentionally broadens to unassociated foreground runs or measured artifact polling becomes material.

decisions.title: Git-root project configuration resolution
decisions.rationale: projectRootResolution is an opt-in policy for target monorepos with nested Pi configuration. This checkout has one root .pi/settings.json, and the packaged extension cannot safely choose git-root semantics for every consuming project.

decisions.title: Launch, stream, steering, and session reliability fixes
decisions.rationale: Bounded zero-activity startup retries, bounded streamed progress, retryable steering inbox scans, canonical session filtering, foreground metadata propagation, and intercom runtime-ID hygiene are inherited from pi-subagents and strengthen ce-workflow's existing async/RPC flows without local adapters.

decisions.title: Acceptance guidance and FleetView input compatibility
decisions.rationale: Improved invalid-evidence diagnostics, j/k navigation, and structural custom-editor focus detection are upstream schema and TUI behavior. ce-workflow already emits supported acceptance evidence and owns separate dialog key handling, so no compatibility edit is required.

decisions.title: Selective optional comments
decisions.rationale: Planning and adoption choices benefit from caveats, while destructive binary approvals must explicitly disable comments.
decisions.verification: open-question, work-goal, and dirty-recovery tests passed

decisions.title: Mailbox redelivery isolated by session or name plus cwd
decisions.rationale: The broker now prevents a same-named session in another project from receiving queued mail by requiring matching cwd when stable session ID is unavailable. ce-workflow inherits the fix while retaining exact-ID targeting and its pending-run, open-work-item, and active-goal stale-message fences.

decisions.title: Broker framing and inline rendering fixes
decisions.rationale: Fragmented-frame reassembly, single-allocation writes, and immutable-message render caching are internal pi-intercom transport/UI improvements. The public tool schema, extension lifecycle, and ce-workflow call sites are unchanged.

decisions.title: Optional project_report orientation for completed-slice verifiers
decisions.rationale: When the host exposes pi-lens project_report, background verifiers now use a lens-enabled read-only role to inspect graph trust/status and prioritize optimization opportunities in the pruned immutable checkpoint. They fall back to the original checkpoint-only role when the tool is absent, never poll a cold graph, and verify every hint through checkpoint-confined tools.
decisions.verification: node scripts/test-background-verifiers.mjs and node scripts/test-work-start-finish.mjs passed, covering the expanded read-only boundary plus pi-lens availability selection and fallback

decisions.title: Review-graph correctness and project scale verdicts
decisions.rationale: Alias, project-reference, workspace-package, and entry-point resolution plus stale pre-cap rejection are internal pi-lens graph behavior inherited by project_report; ce-workflow does not duplicate the graph or cache.

decisions.title: Scan safety, LSP sweep, and disposition fixes
decisions.rationale: Structural walk budgets, home-root refusal, multi-server clean confirmation, warm-up/backpressure fixes, layered config, and immediate cached disposition filtering are inherited from pi-lens. Existing ce-workflow calls remain scoped and its verifier triage store stays separate.

decisions.title: MCP, TSX grammar, YAML, and persistence internals
decisions.rationale: MCP root precedence, TSX ast-grep fallback classification, js-yaml migration, atomic persistence, and auxiliary runtime fixes have no ce-workflow integration surface beyond using the installed host tools.
